## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Session
where: BookingRepository (uses), src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
findBySession(sessionId: string): Booking[] {
=====SOURCE-END=====

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A and B are the same concept. Both refer to the session that bookings point to through a sessionId. In A, BookingRepository looks up bookings with `findBySession(sessionId: string)`. In B, BookingService loads the session with `this.sessions.findById(input.sessionId)` through SessionRepository. In an ice rink booking setting (IceMonitorService, HireStockRepository), 'Session' and 'Skating Session' are the same real-world bookable skating time slot under two names.
